title: Injective fixed raw scalar comparison
statement: For every commutative ring Λ, k:W→S, module sheaf G on W, q∈ℕ, U∈S.Etale and A∈Over(W), the underlying additive map of rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A [def-sbc-raw-module-abelian-hom-map] is injective.

proof.text:
Let two module derived classes have the same image and subtract them.
Resolve A.hom^*G by injective module sheaves and represent the difference by a
cocycle in sections over V = U times_S A.left. Free represented sheaves
corepresent sections after pullback. Forgetting scalars leaves the section
complex unchanged, and Tag 03FD says its terms are acyclic for abelian sections.
Thus its cohomology also computes the target abelian derived Hom group. The
explicit scalar map carries the chosen cocycle to the identical section cocycle:
freeMap sends the identity generator to itself, and the pullback, single and
shift comparisons are the canonical adjunction identifications. Its image being
zero means this section cocycle is a boundary in that same complex. The identical
boundary is a boundary in the module section complex, so the original difference
class is zero. Additivity now proves equality of the two original classes.
The argument applies to degree zero (where boundaries in degree -1 are zero),
the zero ring and empty V.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FD; W3 separates the class detection and class lifting parts of the existing comparison argument

mathlib_searches.query: Injectivity and surjectivity of the derived section comparison from module sheaves to abelian sheaves
Forgetting scalars induces bijection on derived Hom from a free represented module sheaf to a shifted sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Free represented sections equivalences only; no explicit raw scalar map comparison
extAddEquivCohomologyClass exists for injective resolutions, but no scalar comparison
Mathlib bijectivity requires a fully faithful functor preserving injectives; no match for scalar forgetting. No duplicate raw-map clauses in the library/DAG.

    (U : S.Etale) (A : Over W) :
    Function.Injective (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A).hom
